content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria – SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: 1) Educational Qualification​ Additional Mandatory Requirement: ​ As per Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994, Rule 17: Candidates must have passed Matriculation examination with Punjabi as one of the compulsory or elective subjects OR any other equivalent examination in Punjabi language as specified by Punjab Government. Cut-off Date for Qualification: ​ Candidates must possess the required educational/technical qualifications before the last date for submission of online application forms (i.e., 06.04.2026) .

rows.educational_technical_qualification: Should possess 3 years Diploma in Civil Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university or institution; OR who possess higher qualification in same discipline from a recognized university or institution

Should possess 3 years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university or institution; OR who possess higher qualification in same discipline from a recognized university or institution

Should possess 3 years Diploma in Electrical Engineering or its equivalent from a recognized university or institution; OR who possess higher qualification in same discipline from a recognized university or institution

content_sections.heading: 3) Nationality & Domicile​
content_sections.text: Candidates must be residents/domiciled in Punjab State to avail reservation benefits. Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate of Punjab State (not older than 5 years at the time of counselling) is mandatory for all categories (male/female).

content_sections.heading: 4) Category-wise Reservation​
content_sections.text: Reservation is available under the following categories for Punjab State residents only: General EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) – General SC (M & B) – Scheduled Caste (Mazhabi & Balmiki) SC (R & O) – Scheduled Caste (Ramdasia & Others) BC – Backward Class ESM (Ex-Serviceman) – Self & Dependent (for General, SC, BC) Sports Quota (General, SC M&B, SC R&O) PWD (Persons with Disabilities) – Ortho, VH (Visually Handicapped), HH (Hearing Handicapped), ID/MD (Intellectually Disabled/Multiple Disabilities) Freedom Fighter Important: Candidates must select the correct category and category code while applying online. Category and category code cannot be changed at any stage .

faq.question: Q1. What is SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Subordinate Services Selection Board (SSSB), Punjab has released Advertisement No. 7 of 2026 for the recruitment of Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical, and Electrical) posts in Group-B services. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website from 01 Sep 2026 to 09 Sep 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in SSSB Punjab JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Junior Engineer (Civil), Junior Engineer (Mechanical), and Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts under different departments of the Punjab Government. These posts fall under Group-B services and are filled based on demand letters received from departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 will receive a Level-6 pay scale with a starting salary of ₹35,400 per month. Additional allowances and benefits will be provided as per Punjab Government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Punjab JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 3-year Diploma in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized university or institution. Applicants with higher qualifications in the same discipline are also eligible to apply for the respective Junior Engineer post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SSSB Punjab JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 37 years for General category candidates as on 01 January 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories such as SC, BC, Government Employees, Ex-Servicemen, and PWD as per Punjab Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is Punjabi language mandatory for SSSB Punjab JE posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject or an equivalent Punjabi language examination as specified by the Punjab Government. This requirement is mandatory under the Punjab Civil Services Rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of an objective-type written examination (MCQ based) followed by document verification or counselling. Candidates who qualify in the written exam will be called for the next stage of the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for SSSB Punjab JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process reopens on 01-09-2026 and the last date to apply online 09 Sep 2026. The written exam date and admit card release date will be announced later on the official website.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for SSSB Punjab Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online through the official website sssb.punjab.gov.in. Applicants need to fill out the online application form, upload the required documents, pay the application fee, and submit the form before the deadline.

faq.question: Q10. What is the application fee for SSSB Punjab JE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹1500 for General category candidates, ₹750 for SC/BC (Punjab), and ₹500 for ESM/EWS/PWD/LDESM (Punjab). The fee must be paid online before the last date of application submission.
